title: Mixed Event — Don't lose faith! — Episode2 In Order To Get Better

meta.Episode: Episode2 — In Order To Get Better
meta.Event Outline: Now that Shiho has passionately declared that they'll let their music do the talking, she and the rest of Leo/need decide to ramp up their practice in the month leading up to their next show. When that proves to be insufficient, Shiho proposes an intense training program in SEKAI!

rows.Line: A few days later
Rehearsal Studio
se_event_faith_2022_006

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The part that's been giving me trouble lately is coming up next. I need to play each note like I mean it...)
se_event_faith_2022_007

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Yeah, there we go...! That might be the best I've done. All that's left is to play in a way that does the feelings put into this song justice and sprint to the finish...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's been a while since I last went all out like that.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I guess, since I've been so busy getting ready for our shows and keeping an eye on how the others are doing during practice that I haven't had much time to practice like this.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I better make full use of times like this... What the...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What are you all doing standing outside the door? You should've just come in already.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: B-But it looked like you were trying to focus just now, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
We were really awestruck...
We were going to say something, but ended up watching you instead.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, you were on a totally different level! The way you played just now was so cool that we sorta got drawn into your world!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You're saying this now?
You watch me play all the time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But you always try to play at our level, right? We got to see the real you just now...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, okay. I get what you're saying, so let's start practicing already. We don't have a second to waste.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, don't brush us off like that!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now, we've all had a few days to practice on our own, so let's try doing a quick run together today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay.
I should be fine since I managed to get through the practice schedule you gave me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, me too! I also practiced the parts that I found difficult over and over again.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Really...?
Then, I'll be expecting some good results.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm a little nervous since it's going to be our first time playing this song together... But I'm also excited.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, here we go...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They all sound totally different...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They must've practiced a ton until today. They're also playing much cleaner compared to our last show, but...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Saki's trying so hard to stay in time that it's affecting the way Ichika plays her guitar.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And Ichika's doing her best to stay in rhythm with Honami...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami, you're going a bit too fast with the bass drum.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
I-I'm so sorry.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Why don't we try again from the top?
Saki, Ichika, I think you two are being too careful of what others are doing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's not necessarily a bad thing, but worrying too much will mean that you won't be able to play at your best. So, just keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I-I'll be careful!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Alright, once more from the top.
Honami, count us in.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
We can't seem to get it right...
Even after so many attempts...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I think it's a combination of still needing to master it individually and lacking the technical skills for some of the finer parts.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's clear that you all practiced a lot, but you sound a bit lost when we play together since you don't have it completely down yet.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
R-Right...
I felt ready when I was practicing on my own, but I kept doubting myself while we were playing just now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too. I get so worried every time I miss a beat that I end up rushing ahead...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Does this mean that we need to practice more by ourselves instead of trying to play it together...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you all practiced a ton already, right? I feel that we should think of something else instead of repeating the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah.
And we don't have much time. So, what should we do...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Maybe the practice schedules were a little too much for them.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Still, what else can we do?
I can conceivably try teaching them one by one, but I don't know much about other instruments besides bass. We'd be wasting too much time...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (If only there was someone knowledgeable about various instruments we could ask...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think I've got an idea...
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
So, Miku...
We'd like you and the others to do some intense training with us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Intense training?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah.
All of you can play just about any kind of instrument, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I have a feeling that our individual parts still need some work, so if you could all teach us one-on-one...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, we get to be your teachers?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, I like this idea.
Teaching you girls one-on-one should lead to some nice improvements.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But how intense do you want this training to be? It's not going to be as simple as coming over to SEKAI, practicing and going home afterwards, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Exactly.
We don't have much time left until our next show...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, I want to do as much as possible. During the week, I want us to come straight here after school, and stay over on weekends.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
S-Seriously?!
That sounds like a training camp!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But having a sleepover sounds really fun☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rin, they're not doing this for fun...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I... I know that!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I know I'm asking a lot but...
Would you help us out...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I-I'd like to ask the same!
We need all of you guys' help if we're gonna put on the best show ever...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I don't mind.
Especially if it means helping you girls out.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I agree.
Teaching should also be a beneficial experience for us, so I'm in.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, this sounds like a great opportunity! It feels more like a joint practice than a training session.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally!
I can't wait to practice together♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
...!
Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Still, we're so blessed...
We essentially each get to have our own personal tutors.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'm gonna make the most of this opportunity by learning as much as I possibly can from you guys!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Me too.
Let's do everything we can so that we'll be ready for our next show!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. That means we'll have to do our best to make that goal a reality.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks, we really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was thinking that we could start tomorrow. Would you and the others be okay with that, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In that case, we may want to discuss how we're actually going to teach them...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I agree.
Let's do that right after we're finished here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In the meantime, we'll keep practicing like normal while also preparing for you guys' tutelage.

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki & Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (We get to spend entire days practicing, and even have sleepovers...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(This is gonna be so much fun♪
I can't wait for tomorrow!)
